text:
Wide is the sea; it must separate us;

our souls will remain entwined.

Like one last portrait, in our eyes

our gazes will shine impressed.


The ship I must take is in the harbor;

after this one, another will follow for you.

My arms will wait for you, I do not know where...

perhaps in some harbor... on a beach...!

translation.title: Wide Is the Sea; It Must Separate Us
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the lovers separated by ships while their gazes remain imprinted.
